components.name: Footer Surface
components.description: Full-width engraved waterfront behind the drawing grid. Independent fuzzy fog and sailing boats use transform/opacity loops. A separate playback cell freezes/resumes the scene; offscreen and reduced-motion states are still. Foreground link groups share an even feathered paper veil instead of hard individual label patches and the whole bridge/skyline remains framed. Appearance follows the system until manually chosen; a persistent sun/moon control shares the credit row with playback, after a content-width copyright cell. Dark mode preserves the red bridge in a negative engraving. Night mist is independently pale, blurred and vertically thinned; only the waterfront and boats receive the negative-ink filter.

narrative.overview:
Floodwall is an engineering surface arranged as a small deck of white slides on a neutral gray plane. The masthead rests directly on that plane; each page section becomes its own square, finely outlined sheet, with a measured gutter between sheets. Open navigation and direct black actions keep the frame calm while the sections hold complex infrastructure policy.

The animated decision boundary remains the signature: a dense, irregular intake resolves through a gate, a linked recording step, and checked production output. The illustration's green, amber, and red are reserved for verdicts and recorded outcomes. On wide screens, the hero and each of the four following sections read as five slides in a presentation deck. On phones and tablets, those same sheets grow naturally into one continuous scroll.
keyCharacteristics: White framed section sheets and footer against a neutral-gray canvas plane.
Near-black actions and headings; shared drawing-title bands and fine gray rules organize the evidence.
Geist for interface and explanatory text; Geist Mono for code and diagram zone labels.
Outcome colors communicate admit, defer, or reject states only.

rules.name: The Outcome-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Use green, amber, and red to encode real verdict or outcome states. Do not use them as general decoration or as alternate action colors.

rules.name: The One Interface Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Geist for headings, prose, navigation, and actions; use Geist Mono only for code-like data and technical diagram labels.

rules.name: The One Section per Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep every major section and the footer on its own outlined white surface, with the gray canvas visible between sheets.

dos: Do frame major sections and the footer as separate square white sheets on the neutral gray plane.
Do use fine rules and open columns to organize ordered evidence.
Do keep navigation open, comfortably spaced, and clearly stateful without filled tabs.
Do preserve a high-contrast focus outline on links and controls.
Do reserve outcome colors for actual decisions and production state.
Do keep surfaces, controls and image corners square, and the sticky masthead borderless.
donts: Don't add shadows or translucent cards; the system's depth comes from the sheet spacing, contrast, and rules.
Don't reintroduce orange as a brand accent or general-purpose action color.
Don't introduce a second display typeface or use monospace for explanatory prose.
